derivedFields.obligations[].profiles: Derived from profileObligations by obligation id; authored obligations.jsonl rows must not contain profiles.

obligations.title: Battle movement, Stand/Drop Prone, Grapple/Escape/Release, and caller-supplied Opportunity Attack frontier facts

parityWitnesses.deterministicReplayRationale: Shove outcome replay is a closed six-case fixture: save succeeds, failed save applies Prone, failed save emits a 5-foot pushed disposition, failed save emits blocked and no-legal-destination 5-foot dispositions, and invalid push distance is rejected. The replay also asserts accepted outcomes spend the Attack resource while rejected table facts leave it available.

obligations.title: Battle Shove applies Prone or emits a non-OA 5-foot pushed/blocked table disposition and spends the Attack resource on accepted outcomes
Battle Reaction offer, decline, spend, bounded continuation resume, and damage-triggered Concentration Saving Throw protocol
Battle Unit feature procedure profiles for supported action, bonus action, reaction, passive, resource, and active-effect shapes
Battle spell invocation, slot spend, healing, reaction spell, and readied spell procedure profiles
Battle Sanctuary ward creation, direct-targeting interdiction, replacement target selection, area-effect exclusion, and target-action early end
Battle Stat Block action, Multiattack, limited-use, recharge, reaction, and legendary action controls

parityWitnesses.deterministicReplayRationale: Ability, skill, and Search replay is a closed fixture: Search fails and succeeds against a hidden target, Guidance stores the selected skill through the QNT roll-modifier owner, and Enhance Ability stores a selected ability for Ability Check Advantage. The same witness also includes Command so the Task 5 hole families are checked together without random branch exploration.

obligations.title: Battle Search target and Ability Check holes plus spell skill and ability choices feed reducer legality and Ability Check state

parityWitnesses.deterministicReplayRationale: Command replay is a closed fixture tied to the QNT Command branch helper used by battleRuntimeGroundCommand: failed-save Grovel records a pending option, Grovel applies Prone and ends the turn, Drop emits one held-object drop without owning object inventory, Halt suppresses Action/Bonus Action/Movement until end turn, Approach covers continued movement, within-5-foot turn end, and no-movement cleanup, and Flee covers full-budget movement, partial-budget rejection, no-movement cleanup, and opportunity-attack continuation.

obligations.title: Battle Command option choice applies failed-save pending effects and RAW-fixed next-turn reducer consequences while route and object facts stay table-owned
Battle attack target legality, Attack Roll hit/miss/Critical Hit, damage dice, and Attack action resource-spend branches
Battle spell attack and Saving Throw damage branches for hit, miss, Critical Hit, full damage, half damage, and no damage outcomes
Battle damage type choice and Resistance spell damage-reduction rolls feed by-type damage math and once-per-turn use state

parityWitnesses.deterministicReplayRationale: Attack damage disposition replay is a two-case closed fixture: accepted melee Knock Out and rejected ranged Knock Out. Zero-Hit-Point replacement remains covered by the focused feature MBT witness because it is selected by supported feature state rather than a generic table choice.

obligations.title: Battle attack damage disposition offers ordinary damage, Knock Out, or zero-Hit-Point replacement before shared HP damage lifecycle application
Battle start-turn Death Saving Throw holes apply shared death-save success, failure, Stable, death, and natural-20 recovery lifecycle
Character Creation draft hole discovery, atomic fill batch, rediscovery, and finalization status for the established supported slice

parityWitnesses.deterministicReplayRationale: Armor Class base formula is a scalar projection fixture with explicitly named selected-identity cases; random branch interleavings are not the risk for this obligation.

obligations.title: Character Sheet Armor Class base formula selection from build, loadout, and class-feature facts
